name: Warden Pike

intro.text: Halt! This bog is being pre-surfaced for a car park. Sixty spaces, two disabled, one for the Chairman.
You'll need a permit to stand on it. It's a form. It's mostly a form about forms.

win: The bog won. The bog always wins. I'll file that under 'ground conditions'.
after: Apparently you can't tarmac eight thousand years of moss. Who knew. Well, everyone. Everyone knew.
